text:
Viktor Horvat has been a key contributor to our embedded systems team at EcomLogic for over two years. As a senior engineer, he balances hands-on technical work with mentoring junior developers, ensuring alignment between hardware and software goals. His expertise in firmware development and Embedded Linux has been critical to stabilizing our product’s core architecture, particularly during scalability challenges.  

Daily, Viktor tackles complex integration tasks, such as refining hardware-software interactions for real-time inventory tracking. He regularly designs REST APIs to bridge device data with backend systems, and his Python scripts automate repetitive testing workflows. His deep knowledge of C/C++ allows him to optimize low-level performance without compromising code readability. While IoT protocols like MQTT are occasionally used for device communication, his focus remains on reliable, scalable solutions.  

A standout moment came when Viktor re-engineered a failing firmware update process, reducing deployment errors by 70% and minimizing downtime. His ability to diagnose hardware-software conflicts under pressure—such as resolving a sensor calibration issue during a critical product launch—demonstrates his problem-solving grit. Beyond technical skills, Viktor’s collaborative approach and reliability make him a trusted teammate in our fast-paced environment.  

I recommend Viktor strongly for any role requiring technical depth and adaptability. His work ethic, combined with a knack for turning complex challenges into polished solutions, positions him as a valuable asset to any team.
